en.t: A temple to Sol Invictus is dedicated in Rome by Emperor Aurelian
en.s: Sol Invictus (Classical Latin: [ˈsoːɫ ɪnˈwɪktʊs], 'Invincible Sun' or 'Unconquered Sun') was the official sun god of the late Roman Empire and a later aspect of, or replacement for, the old Latin god Sol. The emperor Aurelian revived his cult in AD 274 and promoted Sol Invictus as the chief god of the empire.

zh.t: 奥勒良皇帝在罗马为无敌太阳神庙举行奉献仪式
zh.s: 无敌太阳神（古典拉丁语：Sol Invictus，意为“不可战胜的太阳”或“未被征服的太阳”）是罗马帝国晚期的官方太阳神，也是旧拉丁太阳神索尔的后续形态或替代神祇。公元274年，皇帝奥勒良复兴了对他的崇拜，并将其尊为帝国主神。

en.t: Roman Emperor Constantine the Great elevates his youngest son Constans to the rank of Caesar
en.s: Constantine I (27 February 272 – 22 May 337), also known as Constantine the Great, was Roman emperor from AD 306 to 337 and the first Roman emperor to convert to Christianity. He played a pivotal role in elevating the status of Christianity in the Roman Empire, the Edict of Milan decriminalising Christian practice and ceasing Christian persecution. This was a turning point in the Christianisation of the Roman Empire.

zh.t: 君士坦丁大帝册封幼子君士坦斯为凯撒
zh.s: 君士坦丁一世（272年2月27日—337年5月22日），又称君士坦丁大帝，自公元306年至337年任罗马皇帝，也是首位皈依基督教的罗马皇帝。他通过《米兰敕令》使基督教信仰合法化、停止迫害基督徒，在提升基督教于罗马帝国的地位方面发挥了关键作用。这成为罗马帝国基督教化进程的转折点。

en.t: Vetranio meets Constantius II at Naissus (Serbia) and is forced to abdicate his imperial title. Constantius allows him to live as a private citizen on a state pension
en.s: Constantius II (Latin: Flavius Julius Constantius; Ancient Greek: Κωνστάντιος, romanized: Kōnstántios; 7 August 317 – 3 November 361) was Roman emperor from 337 to 361. His reign saw constant warfare on the borders against the Sasanian Empire and Germanic peoples, while internally the Roman Empire went through repeated civil wars, court intrigues, and usurpations. His religious policies inflamed domestic conflicts that would continue after his death.

zh.t: 维特拉尼奥在纳伊苏斯会见君士坦提乌斯二世并退位
zh.s: 350年12月25日，维特拉尼奥在纳伊苏斯会见君士坦提乌斯二世，被迫放弃帝号。君士坦提乌斯二世允许他以平民身份生活，并发给他国家年金。

en.t: Pope Leo III crowns Charlemagne emperor in Rome
en.s: Pope Leo III crowned Charlemagne emperor during Christmas Mass at St. Peter's Basilica in Rome on December 25. The coronation restored an imperial title in western Europe and became a defining event in the history of the Carolingian Empire.

zh.t: 教宗良三世在罗马为查理曼加冕为皇帝
zh.s: 公元800年12月25日圣诞弥撒期间，教宗良三世在罗马圣伯多禄大殿为查理曼加冕。此次加冕恢复了西欧的皇帝称号，成为加洛林帝国历史上的重要事件。

en.t: Eastern Emperor Leo V is murdered in a church of the Great Palace of Constantinople by followers of Michael II
en.s: The Great Palace of Constantinople (Greek: Μέγα Παλάτιον, Méga Palátion; Latin: Palatium Magnum), also known as the Sacred Palace (Greek: Ἱερὸν Παλάτιον, Hieròn Palátion; Latin: Sacrum Palatium), was the large imperial Byzantine palace complex located in the south-eastern end of the peninsula today making up the Fatih district of Istanbul (formerly Constantinople), in modern Turkey.

zh.t: 东罗马皇帝利奥五世遇刺
zh.s: 君士坦丁堡大皇宫（希腊语：Μέγα Παλάτιον；拉丁语：Palatium Magnum），又称圣宫（希腊语：Ἱερὸν Παλάτιον；拉丁语：Sacrum Palatium），是拜占庭帝国的大型皇宫建筑群，位于半岛东南端；该地如今属于土耳其伊斯坦布尔法提赫区，旧称君士坦丁堡。

en.s: The Battle of Iskhabad (Persian: نبرد اسحاق‌آباد), was a major engagement fought in 940 at Iskhabad, near Ray, between the Samanids, led by Abu 'Ali Chaghani, and the combined forces of the Ziyarids and Firuzanids under the Emir Vushmgir and Makan ibn Kaki. During the first phase of the battle, Vushmgir fled from the battlefield, leaving Makan behind.

zh.s: 940年12月25日，萨曼王朝军队与齐亚尔王朝、菲鲁赞王朝联军在雷伊附近的伊斯哈巴德交战。齐亚尔王朝埃米尔乌什姆吉尔一度逃离战场，留下马坎继续作战。

en.t: The foundation of the Kingdom of Hungary: Hungary is established as a Christian kingdom by Stephen I of Hungary
en.s: The Kingdom of Hungary was a monarchy in Central Europe that existed for nearly a millennium, from 1000 to 1946. The Catholic kingdom emerged as a continuation of the Grand Principality of Hungary upon the coronation of the first king Stephen I at Esztergom around 1000; his family (the Árpád dynasty) led the monarchy for 300 years. By the 12th century, the kingdom had become a European power.

zh.t: 匈牙利王国建立：伊什特万一世建立基督教王国
zh.s: 匈牙利王国是中欧的一个君主国，存在近千年（1000—1946年）。天主教王国由匈牙利大公国延续而来，首位国王伊什特万一世约于1000年在埃斯泰尔戈姆加冕；阿尔帕德王朝统治该国约300年。到12世纪，匈牙利王国已成为欧洲强国。

en.t: Sweyn Forkbeard takes control of the Danelaw and is proclaimed king of England
en.s: Swein Forkbeard (died 3 February 1014) was King of Denmark from c. 986 and briefly King of England from December 1013. He was also overlord of Norway c. 986 – c. 994 and from c. 1000. He married the sister of Boleslaus, ruler of Poland, and had three known children by her: King Harald II of Denmark, King Cnut of England, and Estrid, the mother of Sweyn Estridsson, who became king of Denmark in 1047.

zh.t: 斯文·叉胡须控制丹麦法区并被拥立为英格兰国王
zh.s: 斯温·叉胡须（1014年2月3日去世）约自986年起担任丹麦国王，并于1013年12月短暂成为英格兰国王。他还约于986年至994年以及约1000年起成为挪威的宗主。他娶了波兰统治者博莱斯瓦夫的姐妹，两人有三个已知子女：丹麦国王哈拉尔二世、英格兰国王克努特，以及埃斯特丽德。埃斯特丽德是斯文·埃斯特里德森之母，后者于1047年成为丹麦国王。

en.t: Coronation of Mieszko II Lambert as king of Poland
en.s: Mieszko II Lambert (Polish pronunciation: [ˈmjɛʂkɔ ˈdruɡʲi ˈlambɛrt] ; c. 990 – 10/11 May 1034) was King of Poland from 1025 to 1031 and Duke from 1032 until his death. He was the second son of Bolesław I the Brave but the eldest born from his third wife, Emnilda of Lusatia. He organized two devastating invasions of Saxony in 1028 and 1030.

zh.t: 波兰国王梅什科二世加冕
zh.s: 梅什科二世·兰贝特（波兰语发音：[ˈmjɛʂkɔ ˈdruɡʲi ˈlambɛrt]；约990年—1034年5月10日或11日）于1025年至1031年任波兰国王，1032年起任公爵直至去世。他是勇者博莱斯瓦夫一世的次子，但也是其父与第三任妻子卢萨蒂亚的埃姆尼尔达所生的长子。他曾于1028年和1030年两度大举入侵萨克森，造成严重破坏。

en.t: Henry III is crowned Holy Roman Emperor by Pope Clement II
en.s: The Holy Roman Emperor, originally and officially the Emperor of the Romans (Latin: Imperator Romanorum; German: Kaiser der Römer) during the Middle Ages, and also known as the Roman-German Emperor since the early modern period (Latin: Imperator Germanorum; German: Römisch-deutscher Kaiser), was the ruler and head of state of the Holy Roman Empire.

zh.t: 亨利三世加冕为神圣罗马皇帝
zh.s: 神圣罗马皇帝最初和正式的称号是“罗马人的皇帝”（拉丁语：Imperator Romanorum；德语：Kaiser der Römer）；中世纪以后，也称“罗马—德意志皇帝”（拉丁语：Imperator Germanorum；德语：Römisch-deutscher Kaiser）。他是神圣罗马帝国的统治者和国家元首。

en.t: William the Conqueror, Duke of Normandy is crowned king of England, at Westminster Abbey, London
en.s: William the Conqueror (c. 1028 – 9 September 1087), sometimes called William the Bastard, was the first Norman king of England (as William I), reigning from 1066 until his death. A descendant of Rollo, he was Duke of Normandy (as William II) from 1035 onward. By 1060, following a long struggle, his hold on Normandy was secure.

zh.t: 征服者威廉在伦敦加冕为英格兰国王
zh.s: 征服者威廉（约1028年—1087年9月9日），有时也称私生子威廉，是第一位诺曼裔英格兰国王威廉一世，自1066年起统治至去世。他是罗洛的后裔，自1035年起以威廉二世之名担任诺曼底公爵。经过长期斗争，到1060年他已稳固控制诺曼底。

en.s: On 25 December 1084, at the Battle of Piedra Pisada, the Taifa of Zaragoza fought and probably defeated the Kingdom of Aragon on the road south from Naval to El Grado. The battle was a minor engagement of the ongoing Reconquista of Aragon, the process by which the riverine valleys of the southern slopes of the Pyrenees were gradually conquered and returned, after centuries of Muslim rule, to the control of Christian princes. The ruler of Aragon, who personally led his men in battle at Piedra Pisada, Sancho Ramírez, also ruled Kingdom of Navarre and was a major figure in the contemporary Reconquista.

zh.s: 1084年12月25日，萨拉戈萨泰法王国军队在皮耶德拉皮萨达与阿拉贡王国军队交战，并可能击败了对方。阿拉贡国王桑乔·拉米雷斯亲自率军参战；这场小规模战斗是阿拉贡收复失地战争的一部分。战场位于纳瓦尔通往埃尔格拉多的道路上。

en.t: Baldwin of Boulogne is crowned the first King of Jerusalem in the Church of the Nativity in Bethlehem
en.s: The monarch of Jerusalem was the supreme ruler of the Kingdom of Jerusalem, a Crusader state founded in Jerusalem by the Latin Catholic leaders of the First Crusade, when the city was conquered in 1099. Most of them were men, but there were also five queens regnant of Jerusalem, either reigning alone suo jure ("in her own right"), or as co-rulers of husbands who reigned as kings of Jerusalem jure uxoris ("by right of his wife").

zh.t: 鲍德温一世在伯利恒加冕为耶路撒冷首任国王
zh.s: 耶路撒冷君主是耶路撒冷王国的最高统治者。该十字军国家由拉丁天主教十字军领袖于1099年攻占耶路撒冷后建立。历任君主大多为男性，但也有五位女性在位女王：她们有的以自身权利单独统治（suo jure），有的则作为共治者，与凭妻子权利统治的丈夫共同执政（jure uxoris）。

en.t: Count Roger II of Sicily is crowned the first king of Sicily
en.s: Roger II or Roger the Great (Italian: Ruggero II, Sicilian: Ruggeru II, Greek: Ρογέριος; 22 December 1095 - 26 February 1154) was King of Sicily and Africa, son of Roger I of Sicily and successor to his brother Simon. He began his rule as Count of Sicily in 1105, became Duke of Apulia and Calabria in 1127, then King of Sicily in 1130 and King of Africa in 1148.

zh.t: 西西里伯爵罗杰二世加冕为首任西西里国王
zh.s: 罗杰二世，又称罗杰大帝（意大利语：Ruggero II；西西里语：Ruggeru II；希腊语：Ρογέριος；1095年12月22日—1154年2月26日），是西西里与非洲之王，西西里伯爵罗杰一世之子，也是其兄西蒙的继承人。他于1105年开始以西西里伯爵身份统治，1127年成为阿普利亚和卡拉布里亚公爵，1130年成为西西里国王，1148年成为非洲国王。

en.t: Charles IV, Holy Roman Emperor, promulgates the Golden Bull, a constitution for his empire
en.s: Charles IV (German: Karl IV.; Czech: Karel IV.; Latin: Carolus IV; also known as Charles of Luxembourg German: Karl von Luxemburg; Czech: Karel Lucemburský; Latin: Carolus Luxemburgensis; Luxembourgish: Karel vu Lëtzebuerg; born Wenceslaus German: Wenzel; Czech: Václav; 14 May 1316 – 29 November 1378) was Holy Roman Emperor from 1355 until his death in 1378.

zh.t: 查理四世颁布《金玺诏书》
zh.s: 查理四世（德语：Karl IV；捷克语：Karel IV；拉丁语：Carolus IV），又称卢森堡的查理（德语：Karl von Luxemburg；捷克语：Karel Lucemburský；拉丁语：Carolus Luxemburgensis；卢森堡语：Karel vu Lëtzebuerg），本名瓦茨拉夫（德语：Wenzel；捷克语：Václav；1316年5月14日—1378年11月29日），自1355年起任神圣罗马皇帝，直至1378年去世。

en.s: The siege of La Charité was incited by the order of Charles VII to Joan of Arc after the warlord Perrinet Gressard seized the town in 1423. La Charité was not only strongly fortified, but fully victualled for a prolonged siege. Joan's forces were known to be poorly equipped with artillery. On November 7, 1429, the people of Clermont were addressed with a letter asking the town to send supplies to Joan's army for the siege.

zh.s: 1423年，军阀佩里内·格雷萨尔夺取拉沙里泰后，查理七世下令圣女贞德围攻该城。拉沙里泰防御坚固，粮草也足以支撑长期围城。贞德的部队则以火炮装备不足著称。1429年11月7日，克莱蒙居民收到一封信，信中请求该镇向贞德的军队运送围城所需补给。

en.s: The Battle of Gomit or Battle of Egubba (or Battle of Ayfars was fought in 1445 between the Ethiopian Empire and a powerful Muslim army under the Adal Sultanate. The Ethiopians were led by Emperor Zara Yaqob, while the forces of Adal were led by Sultan Badlay ibn Sa'ad ad-Din. The Ethiopian army was victorious, and Badlay was slain.

zh.s: 1445年12月25日，埃塞俄比亚帝国与阿达尔苏丹国军队在戈米特交战。埃塞俄比亚皇帝扎拉·雅各布率军取胜，阿达尔苏丹巴德莱阵亡。

en.s: The siege of Jajce was a siege of the town of Jajce and its citadel in 1463, in a push by Ottomans to conquer as much of the Bosnian Kingdom, and continuation of the Ottoman–Hungarian Wars. After the fall of Travnik and royal fortress of Bobovac, in the initial days of invasion, Ottomans, led by the Sultan, captured the town.

zh.s: 1463年，奥斯曼帝国为尽可能征服波斯尼亚王国而围攻雅伊采及其城堡，这也是奥斯曼—匈牙利战争的延续。入侵初期，特拉夫尼克和王室堡垒博博瓦茨陷落后，苏丹率领的奥斯曼军队攻占了雅伊采。

en.s: The Second Battle of Acentejo took place on 25 December 1494 between the invading Spanish forces and the natives of the island of Tenerife, known as Guanches. The battle had been preceded by the Battle of Aguere, fought on 14-15 November that year, which had been a Castilian victory.

zh.s: 1494年12月25日，西班牙入侵军与特内里费岛原住民关切人交战。此前，卡斯蒂利亚军队在11月14日至15日的阿圭雷战役中获胜。

en.s: The Battle of Tucapel (also known as the Disaster of Tucapel) is the name given to a battle fought between Spanish conquistador forces led by Pedro de Valdivia and Mapuche (Araucanian) Indians under Lautaro that took place at Tucapel, Chile on December 25, 1553. This battle happened in the context of the first stage of the Arauco War, named the "offensive war" within a larger uprising by Araucanians against the Spanish conquest of Chile. It was a defeat for the Spaniards, resulting in the capture and eventual death of Valdivia.

zh.s: 1553年12月25日，佩德罗·德·巴尔迪维亚率领的西班牙征服者与劳塔罗率领的马普切人（阿劳卡尼亚人）在智利图卡佩尔交战。西班牙军队战败，巴尔迪维亚被俘，后来遇害。这场战斗是阿劳科战争初期“进攻战争”阶段的一部分，也是马普切人反抗西班牙征服的更大规模起义的一环。

en.t: Pope Pius IV is elected, four months after his predecessor's death
en.s: Pope Pius IV (Italian: Pio IV; 31 March 1499 – 9 December 1565), born Giovanni Angelo Medici, was head of the Catholic Church and ruler of the Papal States from 25 December 1559 to his death, in December 1565. Born in Milan, his family considered itself a branch of the House of Medici and used the same coat of arms.

zh.s: 教宗庇护四世（意大利语：Pio IV），本名乔瓦尼·安杰洛·美第奇（1499年3月31日—1565年12月9日），自1559年12月25日起担任天主教会领袖和教宗国统治者，直至1565年12月去世。他出生于米兰；其家族自视为美第奇家族的一个分支，并使用同一纹章。

en.s: The assault on Greifenhagen occurred on 25 December 1630 during the earlier stages of the Swedish intervention in the Thirty Years' War when a Swedish force of 13,000–18,000 men attacked the town of Greifenhagen in order to make way for an attack on the main Imperial camp at Gartz. The Swedes initially on arrival could not attack the town right away, and instead set up camp in the nearby forest.

zh.s: 1630年12月25日，瑞典军队在三十年战争期间进攻格赖芬哈根镇，意在为攻击加茨的帝国军主营开路。瑞典军队有1.3万至1.8万人；抵达后未能立即进攻，便先在附近森林扎营。

en.s: The Conquest of Paraíba refers to the attempts by Dutch forces in 1630 to seize control of Paraíba, Brazil, from the Portuguese, mainly for the lucrative sugar cane market.

en.s: The siege of Baghdad (Persian: محاصره بغداد) in the winter of 1638 marked the re-establishment of Ottoman control over Iraq, following a prior period of Safavid rule. It was part of the Ottoman–Safavid War of 1623–1639.

en.s: The Siege of Kolding was fought on December 25, 1658, between Sweden and the forces of the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth and Denmark–Norway. The Polish and Danish forces were led by Stefan Czarniecki. The Polish-Danish force won the battle.

zh.s: 1658年12月25日，瑞典军队与波兰—立陶宛联邦、丹麦—挪威联军在科灵交战。斯特凡·恰尔涅茨基率领波兰和丹麦军队，最终联军获胜。

en.t: J. S. Bach leads the first performance of Gelobet seist du, Jesu Christ, BWV 91, in Leipzig, based on Luther's 1524 Christmas hymn
en.s: Gelobet seist du, Jesu Christ (Praise be to You, Jesus Christ), BWV 91, is a church cantata by Johann Sebastian Bach. He wrote the Christmas cantata in Leipzig in 1724 for Christmas Day and first performed it on 25 December. It is based on the hymn "Gelobet seist du, Jesu Christ" by Martin Luther which was 200 years old when Bach wrote the work.

en.s: The Battle of Lake Okeechobee was one of the major battles of the Second Seminole War. It was fought between 800 troops of the 1st, 4th, and 6th Infantry Regiments and 132 Missouri Volunteers (under the command of Colonel Zachary Taylor), and between 380 and 480 Seminoles led by Billy Bowlegs, Abiaca, and Alligator on 25 December 1837. The Seminole warriors were resisting forced relocation to a reservation out west.
